findings.summary: The degenerate-path test for the tools package deletes the top-level registry module without seeding a replacement and returns early when a tools module already exists, so the asserted import either fails or passes vacuously depending on the environment.

The broken_catalog fixture clears only the load_catalog cache inside its writer, so a prior tool_specs call can serve a stale pre-mutation roster despite the fixture's advertised call-order independence.

The integration test still carries a verbatim duplicate of the Hermes-style loader beside the parameterized conftest implementation; the round-one reuse remediation did not land and the parameterization is currently dead code, leaving the two copies free to drift.

The e2e test pins two exact Plugin Doctor output phrases deliberately as the doctor-contract assertion; the removed round-one assertion was the unanchored lowercase error-word heuristic, not these pins.
Prepare applies ruff format rather than --check because aquarium-test-contract/v1 defines prepare as applying meaning-preserving formatting before the deterministic checks.
